li.label: a stiff toe
li.description: My big toe is stiff and warm. I know what's coming.

li.label: gout
li.description: My big toe is swollen and red, and even the blanket on it hurts. All that good food.

li.label: a dusty throat
li.description: I can still taste the stone dust. Every breath scratches a little.

li.label: a stone-dust cough
li.description: I cough every time I start to speak. The dust is still down in my chest.

li.label: stiff knees
li.description: My knees creak when I stand up, after all that time on them.

li.label: sore knees
li.description: My knees are puffy and sore. Kneeling is out of the question for a while.

li.label: an itchy ring
li.description: There's a red ring on my arm that itches all the time, and I mustn't scratch it.

li.label: worms
li.description: I'm hungry an hour after every meal, and I know why. I don't like to think about it.

li.label: a morning cough
li.description: I cough for the first hour every morning now.

li.label: a smoker's cough
li.description: I hack and wheeze before breakfast. Maybe I should cut down.

li.label: bee stings
li.description: The bees got me. My hand is hot and puffy and throbs when I grip anything.
